lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast white stripes are visible across the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming more compressed toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped convergence is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 5th and 6th stripes (counting from the posterior).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 1, 2, 11, and 12 exhibit abbreviated lengths, terminating in the mid-flank without reaching the ventral or dorsal boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are located on the posterior haunch, arranged in a vertical orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct white spots on the facial region (two on the lower cheek, one near the muzzle) and a prominent white patch on the lower throat.
